assets.name: river-night-sky
assets.prompt: Empty background: a calm city riverbank skyline at night, seen from far away across wide dark water. A deep navy sky with a few faint stars fills the top two thirds. A low, distant line of dark buildings along the far bank with a few small warm window lights, reflected as soft streaks in the still water below. No wheel, no fairground, no rides, no bridges in the middle. Completely empty of people and animals: no people, no figures, no faces. No signs, no text anywhere. Muted, low contrast and dark, made to sit behind a dark user interface.
assets.local_note: shown at about 30 percent opacity behind the wheel pane in Ride and Match; keep the middle and top empty and dark, no people, no wheel
assets.sd: A wide calm river at night seen from far away. Deep navy sky with a few faint stars fills the top two thirds. Along the far bank, a low flat line of dark warehouses and rooftops with a few small warm window lights, reflected as soft streaks in the still dark water. Nothing tall, nothing round, minimal and empty. Muted, low contrast, very dark.
